'''Brian Kennedy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Cedar Grove tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ with high destiny]], according to Chad Samuels's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1536">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-cedar-grove-1292000d1536/ cedar-grove-1292000], DeckTech (Chad "JadesFire" Samuels, 11 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-cedar-grove-1292000d1536/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
